child.special_advice: Rare in children but requires specialist paediatric dermatology care urgently when it occurs.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling supportive diet alongside medical care. No herbal applications on open blisters.

teenager.special_advice: Very rare in teenagers. Any large blistering condition requires urgent dermatology assessment.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and rest support Pitta reduction alongside medical treatment.

elderly.special_advice: Most common in elderly over 70. Regular skin checks and monitoring for medication triggers are essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Kapha imbalance with age needs cooling nourishing approach alongside careful medical management.

western.description: skin inflammation of the lower legs caused by poor venous circulation and fluid leakage into skin tissue
symptoms: redness and swelling of lower legs
open sores or ulcers in severe cases

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: swelling and skin inflammation caused by Vata blocking blood circulation in the lower limbs
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata obstructing Rakta Dhatu circulation in lower limbs causing stagnation, inflammation, and skin changes

dosha_advice.vata: warm sesame oil massage on legs, warm nourishing diet, gentle walking to improve circulation
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling diet to reduce inflammation, elevate legs, cool compresses on inflamed areas
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce fluid retention, regular walking, weight management

ayurvedic_safe: gentle leg massage with sesame oil
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Stasis dermatitis often worsens in pregnancy due to increased venous pressure. Compression stockings and leg elevation are safe and important. Consult your doctor.

child.special_advice: Rare in children. Any leg swelling and skin changes in a child require medical evaluation for underlying causes.
child.ayurvedic_note: Medical evaluation is the priority before any supportive treatment in children.

teenager.special_advice: Uncommon in teenagers. If present, investigate for underlying venous abnormality or post-thrombotic syndrome.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Vata regulation through warm diet and gentle exercise helps improve circulation in teenagers.

elderly.special_advice: Very common in elderly. Compression stockings, leg elevation, and emollients are the cornerstone of daily management.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata dominance in elderly worsens circulation. Warm oil massage and gentle walking are very important daily routines.

diseases.name: Nummular Eczema

western.description: chronic eczema causing coin-shaped itchy patches on the skin often triggered by dry skin or skin injury
symptoms: patches on arms legs and trunk
causes: skin injury or insect bite trigger

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: circular coin-shaped itching skin patches caused by Vata-Pitta imbalance
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing extreme dryness in skin with Pitta causing inflammation and oozing in circular patterns

prevention: moisturize skin daily especially in dry weather

dosha_advice.vata: daily warm sesame oil massage, nourishing warm diet, avoid cold dry weather exposure
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling aloe vera on patches, cooling diet, avoid spicy foods and heat
dosha_advice.kapha: regular moisturizing, gentle exercise, avoid heavy diet

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, American Academy of Dermatology

unsafe_treatments: strong topical steroids on large areas
ayurvedic_safe: aloe vera cooling on inflamed areas
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Nummular eczema may flare during pregnancy. Emollients and gentle care are safe. Consult your doctor before any medicated treatment.

child.special_advice: Keep nails short to prevent skin damage from scratching. Use gentle fragrance-free products. Identify and avoid triggers.
child.ayurvedic_note: Warm sesame oil massage and nourishing diet help reduce Vata dryness causing the condition in children.
safe_treatments: mild topical steroids under paediatric supervision

teenager.special_advice: Stress is a major trigger in teenagers. Psychological support alongside skin treatment is important.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Pitta imbalance responds well to cooling diet, warm oil massage, and stress reduction practices.

elderly.special_advice: Dry skin in elderly is the main trigger. Daily moisturizing immediately after bathing is essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata dominates in elderly causing severe skin dryness. Daily warm oil massage and nourishing diet are the most important interventions.

diseases.name: Lichen Sclerosus

western.description: chronic inflammatory skin condition causing white patchy skin that is thinner than normal often affecting genital and anal areas
complications: small increased risk of squamous cell carcinoma
significant impact on quality of life

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: white skin condition caused by Vata-Kapha imbalance depleting skin tissue
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing extreme dryness and tissue thinning with Kapha causing white discoloration and hardening of affected skin

prevention: avoid skin irritants and tight clothing
annual checks for any skin changes

dosha_advice.vata: nourishing warm diet, gentle sesame oil massage on non-affected surrounding skin, warm environment
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling anti-inflammatory diet, avoid spicy foods and irritants
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce Kapha accumulation, gentle movement, avoid heavy clothing

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, British Association of Dermatologists

safe_treatments: ultra-potent topical steroids under specialist guidance
unsafe_treatments: topical calcineurin inhibitors without specialist approval
ayurvedic_unsafe: strong herbal applications on sensitive skin areas
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Lichen sclerosus requires specialist monitoring in pregnancy. Continue prescribed treatments under specialist supervision. Consult your doctor.

child.special_advice: Lichen sclerosus in children requires specialist care. It is not a sign of abuse but can be confused with it. Specialist evaluation is essential.
child.ayurvedic_note: Gentle nourishing diet and supportive care alongside medical treatment. No herbal applications on sensitive areas in children.

teenager.special_advice: Psychological impact is significant. Specialist care and confidential emotional support are both important.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Kapha balancing diet and gentle lifestyle measures support medical treatment in teenagers.

elderly.special_advice: Most common in post-menopausal women. Annual review for any suspicious skin changes is essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Low estrogen increases Vata in elderly women. Nourishing diet and gentle emollient care are very important supportive measures.

diseases.name: Erythema Nodosum

western.description: inflammatory condition causing painful red nodules under the skin usually on the shins representing a hypersensitivity reaction
symptoms: nodules that are warm and tender
nodules that fade leaving bruise-like marks

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: painful inflammatory nodules caused by Vata-Pitta aggravation in deeper skin tissue
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation in deeper skin and fat tissue causing inflammation, with Vata causing pain and spreading

prevention: rest legs when active flare present

dosha_advice.vata: warm nourishing diet, rest, avoid cold and wind that worsen Vata and pain
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling anti-inflammatory diet, avoid spicy and fermented foods, rest legs
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce swelling, gentle movement when pain allows, avoid heavy food

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Erythema nodosum can occur in pregnancy and usually resolves after delivery. Rest and medical monitoring are the priority. Consult your doctor.

child.special_advice: Usually follows a streptococcal throat infection in children. Treat the underlying infection and rest the child.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and rest support Pitta reduction during the inflammatory episode in children.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate for underlying causes like inflammatory bowel disease or sarcoidosis in teenagers with recurrent episodes.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally high in teenagers. Cooling diet and rest during flares are important.

elderly.special_advice: Investigate thoroughly for underlying systemic disease in elderly with new erythema nodosum.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Pitta imbalance in elderly needs both warming for circulation and cooling for inflammation. Medical evaluation is the priority.

diseases.name: Pyoderma Gangrenosum

western.description: rare autoimmune skin condition causing rapidly enlarging painful ulcers typically on the legs
symptoms: purple or blue overhanging wound edges

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: malignant non-healing ulcer caused by severe Pitta-Vata imbalance in skin tissue
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Severe Pitta aggravation in tissue causing ulceration and tissue destruction, with Vata causing rapid spreading and pain

prevention: avoid skin trauma in patients with known condition

dosha_advice.vata: nourishing warm diet, rest, avoid stress and pain-aggravating activities
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet, avoid all inflammatory foods, cooling herbal support under strict Ayurvedic guidance
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to support tissue healing, avoid heavy foods

ayurvedic_unsafe: any herbal application on open ulcer
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Pyoderma gangrenosum in pregnancy is a medical emergency requiring specialist care immediately. Seek urgent medical attention.

child.special_advice: Very rare in children but requires urgent specialist care. Investigate for underlying immunodeficiency.
child.ayurvedic_note: Medical care is the absolute priority. Supportive nourishing diet helps healing alongside treatment.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate for underlying inflammatory bowel disease in teenagers. Specialist care is essential.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and stress reduction are supportive measures alongside essential medical treatment.

elderly.special_advice: More common in elderly. Check for underlying haematological malignancy. Close specialist monitoring is essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Vata imbalance in elderly requires careful medical management alongside nourishing cooling supportive diet.

western.description: rare genetic condition causing extremely fragile skin that blisters and tears from minor friction or trauma
symptoms: blisters from minor touch or friction
causes: genetic mutations affecting skin structural proteins
inherited from one or both parents
affects proteins like collagen keratin and laminin
complications: skin cancer risk in some types

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: extreme fragility of skin caused by Vata imbalance in skin structural tissue from birth
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Profound Vata imbalance in Tvak Dhatu from birth causing extreme dryness and fragility of skin tissue, with Pitta causing ulceration when blisters form

dosha_advice.vata: highly nourishing warm diet, gentle sesame oil on intact skin, extreme warmth and gentleness
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling diet to reduce inflammation in blistered areas, avoid spicy and acidic foods
dosha_advice.kapha: light nourishing diet to support immunity and healing

ayurvedic_unsafe: any herbal application on blistered skin
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Pregnancy in a person with EB requires specialist multidisciplinary care. Genetic counselling is essential before and during pregnancy.

child.special_advice: EB is primarily a childhood condition. Specialist EB centre care is essential from birth. Family and school education about skin handling is critical.
child.ayurvedic_note: Highly nourishing diet and extreme gentleness in all care are supportive measures alongside specialist medical management.

teenager.special_advice: Teenagers with EB need psychological support alongside medical care. Transition to adult specialist services should be planned carefully.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Nourishing Vata-balancing diet and gentle skin care remain essential throughout teenage years.

elderly.special_advice: Milder forms of EB may only be diagnosed in adulthood. Specialist evaluation and monitoring for skin cancer are essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata increases with age worsening skin fragility. Nourishing diet and extremely gentle skin care are lifelong requirements.

western.description: autoimmune inflammatory condition affecting skin and muscles causing characteristic skin rash and muscle weakness

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: skin and muscle inflammatory disorder caused by Pitta-Vata aggravation in muscle and skin tissue
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation in Rakta and Mamsa Dhatu causing simultaneous skin and muscle inflammation, with Vata causing weakness and spreading

dosha_advice.vata: warm nourishing diet to support muscle strength, avoid cold and stress
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet, avoid sun exposure, cooling anti-inflammatory foods
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to support immunity and reduce inflammation

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Dermatomyositis in pregnancy requires specialist rheumatology, dermatology, and obstetrics care together. High-risk pregnancy monitoring is essential.

child.special_advice: Juvenile dermatomyositis requires specialist paediatric rheumatology care. Physiotherapy is essential to maintain muscle function.
child.ayurvedic_note: Nourishing diet and sun protection are supportive alongside specialist medical care in children.

teenager.special_advice: Significant impact on physical activity and self-esteem. Specialist care, physiotherapy, and emotional support are all important.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally elevated in teenagers. Strict cooling diet and sun avoidance are very important supportive measures.

elderly.special_advice: Cancer screening is essential in elderly with new-onset dermatomyositis. Close multidisciplinary monitoring is required.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Pitta imbalance in elderly needs warming for muscle strength and cooling for inflammation. Medical care takes priority.

diseases.name: Sweet's Syndrome

western.description: rare inflammatory skin condition causing sudden appearance of fever and painful skin lesions with dense neutrophil infiltration
symptoms: lesions on face arms and neck
lesions that appear rapidly over days
complications: internal organ involvement in rare cases

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: fever-associated painful skin condition caused by acute Pitta-Rakta aggravation
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Acute Pitta aggravation in Rakta Dhatu causing fever and inflammatory skin lesions with Vata spreading the condition rapidly

prevention: seek medical attention with fever and sudden skin changes

dosha_advice.vata: rest, warm nourishing diet, avoid cold and stress during recovery
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet during and after flare, avoid all spicy and inflammatory foods
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to support immune recovery, avoid heavy and congesting foods

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Sweet's syndrome in pregnancy requires urgent specialist evaluation. It can be associated with pregnancy itself as a trigger. Seek medical care immediately.

child.special_advice: Rare in children. Investigate urgently for infection trigger or underlying haematological condition.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and rest are supportive alongside urgent medical evaluation in children.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate for underlying blood disorder or inflammatory bowel disease in teenagers.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally elevated in teenagers. Cooling diet and rest help support recovery alongside medical treatment.

elderly.special_advice: New onset Sweet's syndrome in elderly must be urgently investigated for haematological malignancy.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Vata imbalance in elderly needs cooling and nourishing support while medical investigation proceeds urgently.

diseases.name: Striae (Stretch Marks)

western.description: linear streaks or bands on the skin caused by rapid stretching of the dermis resulting in scar-like marks
symptoms: pink red or purple streaks initially
fade to white or silver over time
may feel slightly itchy when new
appear on abdomen thighs breasts and arms
causes: rapid skin stretching from weight gain or pregnancy
complications: association with underlying hormonal disorders in some cases

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: splitting and stretching of skin tissue caused by Vata imbalance in skin
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing dryness and loss of elasticity in skin tissue during rapid stretching, with Pitta causing initial inflammation seen as redness

prevention: moisturize skin regularly during pregnancy and growth periods
use vitamin E and collagen-supporting skin oils

dosha_advice.vata: daily warm sesame or coconut oil massage on at-risk areas, nourishing collagen-supporting diet
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling aloe vera gel on new red stretch marks, cooling diet to reduce inflammation
dosha_advice.kapha: regular gentle massage and light diet to maintain healthy weight

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, American Academy of Dermatology

ayurvedic_safe: warm sesame or coconut oil massage on abdomen and thighs
ayurvedic_unsafe: strong herbal applications with unknown safety
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Stretch marks are very common in pregnancy. Regular gentle oil massage is safe and helpful. Avoid retinoid products during pregnancy.

child.special_advice: Stretch marks from rapid growth or obesity in children should prompt review of growth and diet.
child.ayurvedic_note: Nourishing diet and gentle oil massage on at-risk areas help support skin elasticity in growing children.
safe_treatments: medical review if related to obesity

teenager.special_advice: Very common during puberty growth spurts. Reassurance and regular moisturizing are the main management.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Vata peaks during rapid growth in teenage years. Daily oil massage and nourishing collagen-supporting diet are very helpful.

elderly.special_advice: Old stretch marks are permanent but can be managed cosmetically. Investigate if new stretch marks appear in elderly without obvious cause.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata dominance in elderly causes skin thinning. Regular oil massage helps maintain skin health and prevent new marks.
safe_treatments: medical review if new unexplained marks appear

diseases.name: Cherry Angioma

western.description: common benign overgrowth of blood vessels in the skin appearing as bright red cherry-coloured dome-shaped spots
symptoms: may bleed if scratched or injured
complications: rarely multiple spots may indicate internal conditions

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: small red blood-filled spot in skin caused by Pitta-Rakta accumulation
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation in Rakta Dhatu causing localized blood vessel overgrowth, with Kapha contributing to the stable dome-shaped nature of the lesion

prevention: regular dermatology monitoring as they increase with age

dosha_advice.vata: gentle skin care routine, avoid harsh products on surrounding skin
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling diet to reduce Pitta and Rakta aggravation, avoid spicy foods
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce Kapha accumulation, regular gentle exercise

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, American Academy of Dermatology

unsafe_treatments: laser removal unless medically necessary during pregnancy
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Cherry angiomas may increase in number during pregnancy due to hormonal changes. They are benign and monitoring is all that is needed. Consult your doctor if concerned.

child.special_advice: Uncommon in young children. Any red vascular lesion in a child should be evaluated by a doctor to confirm diagnosis.
child.ayurvedic_note: Medical evaluation is important before any home treatment in children.

teenager.special_advice: Can appear in older teenagers. Reassure that they are benign. Annual monitoring is sufficient.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet to balance Pitta helps reduce tendency for vascular overgrowth.

elderly.special_advice: Very common in elderly. Multiple spots are normal with aging. Annual skin check to monitor any changes in appearance is advisable.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Kapha imbalance accumulates with age. Cooling diet and gentle skin care are helpful.
safe_treatments: laser or electrocautery removal if desired under supervision

diseases.name: Spider Angioma

western.description: vascular lesion with a central red spot and radiating blood vessels resembling a spider found on face and upper body
symptoms: central red spot with radiating vessels
found on face chest and arms
usually solitary or few in number
complications: multiple spider angiomas may indicate underlying liver disease

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: circular red vascular lesion caused by Pitta-Rakta aggravation with radiating pattern
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation in Rakta Dhatu causing abnormal blood vessel dilation, with Vata creating the radiating outward pattern

prevention: discuss oral contraceptive alternatives if multiple lesions appear

dosha_advice.vata: nourishing diet to support liver health, avoid erratic eating habits
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling liver-supportive diet, avoid alcohol and spicy foods, bitter vegetables are beneficial
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to support liver function, regular gentle exercise, avoid fatty foods

safe_treatments: liver function check if multiple lesions
unsafe_treatments: laser removal unless cosmetically necessary and safe in pregnancy
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Spider angiomas are common in pregnancy due to elevated estrogen and usually resolve after delivery. Monitoring is sufficient. Consult your doctor if multiple new lesions appear.

child.special_advice: Single spider angioma is common in children and is usually benign. Multiple lesions require liver evaluation.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling liver-supporting diet like bitter foods in small amounts helps balance Pitta in children.
safe_treatments: liver function test if multiple lesions

teenager.special_advice: Single lesions in teenagers are usually benign. Oral contraceptive pill use can cause them in teenage girls.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally high in teenagers. Liver-supporting cooling diet and avoiding alcohol are important.

elderly.special_advice: Multiple spider angiomas in elderly without a known cause require liver function evaluation urgently.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Liver Pitta accumulation increases with age especially with dietary indiscretion. Liver-supportive cooling diet is important.
safe_treatments: laser removal if desired under supervision

diseases.name: Photodermatitis

western.description: abnormal skin reaction to sunlight or UV radiation either as phototoxic or photoallergic response
causes: phototoxic reaction from medications or plants
plant contact followed by sun exposure
triggers: sun exposure after using photosensitizing medications
contact with photosensitizing plants like giant hogweed

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: sun-triggered skin reaction caused by external substance combined with Pitta aggravation
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: External photosensitizing substance combined with solar heat massively aggravating Pitta causing acute skin inflammation

prevention: check all medications and topicals for photosensitizing properties
wear sun protection when on photosensitizing medications
stay out of sun during peak hours when on trigger substances

dosha_advice.vata: soothing nourishing care for skin, avoid stress and cold after a reaction
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet, cooling aloe vera on affected skin, strict sun avoidance
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to support skin healing, sun protection

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, British Association of Dermatologists

safe_treatments: stop triggering substance if safe to do so
ayurvedic_safe: cooling aloe vera on affected areas
ayurvedic_unsafe: strong herbal applications on inflamed skin
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Some photosensitizing medications are also harmful to the baby. Inform your doctor about all medications and sun reactions during pregnancy immediately.

child.special_advice: Plant-contact photodermatitis is common in children playing outdoors. Rinse skin immediately after contact with unknown plants before sun exposure.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling aloe vera on affected areas and Pitta-reducing diet support healing in children.

teenager.special_advice: Teenagers on acne medications like doxycycline must use daily sunscreen. Inform them of photosensitivity risk.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally high in teenagers. Cooling diet and consistent sun protection are doubly important when on photosensitizing drugs.

elderly.special_advice: Elderly on multiple medications are at high risk. Medication review for photosensitizing drugs is important, especially diuretics and antibiotics.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Pitta imbalance in elderly combined with medication burden increases skin sensitivity. Sun protection is essential at all ages.

diseases.name: Asteatotic Eczema

western.description: form of eczema occurring on very dry skin with a characteristic cracked crazy-paving pattern also called eczema craquele
symptoms: dry cracked skin resembling crazy paving
mainly on lower legs in elderly

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: extreme dry cracking skin condition caused by severe Vata aggravation depleting skin moisture
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Severe Vata depletion of moisture and oil in skin causing extreme dryness and cracking, with Pitta causing inflammation in the cracks

prevention: use lukewarm not hot water for bathing
use a humidifier in dry environments

dosha_advice.vata: daily warm sesame oil massage is essential, nourishing warm diet with healthy fats, avoid cold dry environments
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling aloe vera on inflamed cracked areas, gentle non-irritating products
dosha_advice.kapha: regular moisturizing routine, light nourishing diet, stay hydrated

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, British Association of Dermatologists

unsafe_treatments: strong topical steroids on large areas
ayurvedic_safe: nourishing Vata-balancing diet with healthy fats
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Asteatotic eczema is managed safely with emollients in pregnancy. Consult your doctor before using any medicated creams.

child.special_advice: Less common in children but can occur in very dry skin conditions. Regular gentle moisturizing after baths is key.
child.ayurvedic_note: Warm sesame oil massage after bathing is safe, nourishing, and highly effective for dry-skinned children.

teenager.special_advice: Teenagers taking long hot showers worsen dry skin. Shorter lukewarm showers and immediate moisturizing help significantly.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Nourishing Vata-balancing diet with healthy fats like ghee and sesame supports skin hydration from within.

elderly.special_advice: Most common in elderly. Daily moisturizing after bathing is the single most important intervention. Review any diuretic medications.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata dominates in elderly depleting all body moisture. Daily warm sesame oil massage is arguably the most important Ayurvedic intervention for this age group.

diseases.name: Cutaneous Vasculitis

western.description: inflammation of blood vessels in the skin causing characteristic purpuric rash often associated with systemic conditions
symptoms: palpable purpura red-purple spots that do not blanch
causes: immune complex deposition in vessel walls

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: impurity and inflammation in blood vessels caused by Pitta-Rakta aggravation
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation in Rakta Dhatu causing inflammation and damage to blood vessel walls, with Vata causing spread and pain

prevention: compression stockings to reduce lower limb pooling

dosha_advice.vata: warm nourishing diet, rest, avoid cold and stress that aggravate Vata and pain
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling blood-purifying diet, avoid spicy fermented and alcohol, bitter vegetables beneficial
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce inflammatory burden, gentle movement, avoid heavy congesting foods

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Cutaneous vasculitis in pregnancy requires specialist evaluation to rule out systemic involvement that could affect the baby. Seek urgent medical care.

child.special_advice: Henoch-Schonlein Purpura is the most common vasculitis in children often following infection. Monitor for kidney involvement with urine tests.
child.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and rest support Pitta-Rakta reduction in children. Medical monitoring for kidney involvement is essential.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate for underlying systemic disease or medication trigger in teenagers. Kidney function monitoring is important.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is naturally elevated in teenagers. Blood-purifying cooling diet and rest are important supportive measures.

elderly.special_advice: Cutaneous vasculitis in elderly may indicate underlying cancer or systemic disease. Thorough medical investigation is essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Vata imbalance in elderly combined with blood vessel changes needs cooling nourishing support alongside thorough medical investigation.

diseases.name: Panniculitis

western.description: inflammation of the subcutaneous fat layer beneath the skin causing tender nodules or plaques
symptoms: tender nodules or plaques under skin
nodules mainly on lower legs and trunk

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: inflammation of fat tissue beneath the skin caused by Pitta-Kapha aggravation in Medha Dhatu
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation causing inflammation in Medha Dhatu with Kapha causing thickening and nodular accumulation in fat tissue

prevention: regular medical monitoring if prone to recurrence

dosha_advice.vata: warm nourishing diet and protect from cold, avoid stress
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling anti-inflammatory diet, avoid spicy and inflammatory foods, rest affected areas
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce Medha accumulation, avoid heavy fatty foods, gentle exercise when tolerated

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, British Association of Dermatologists

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Panniculitis in pregnancy requires medical evaluation to identify and treat any underlying cause that could affect the pregnancy. Consult your doctor.

child.special_advice: Cold panniculitis from ice pack or popsicle contact is common in young children. Remove cold source and the condition resolves spontaneously.
child.ayurvedic_note: Warming the area gently and protective clothing in cold weather are the main supportive measures for children.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate for systemic cause in teenagers. Rest and managing the underlying condition are the priorities.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet to reduce Pitta inflammation and light Kapha-balancing meals support tissue healing.

elderly.special_advice: Panniculitis in elderly should be investigated for underlying systemic disease including pancreatic disease and lymphoma.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Kapha imbalance in elderly fat tissue needs cooling and light dietary approach alongside thorough medical investigation.

diseases.name: Eruptive Xanthoma

western.description: sudden appearance of yellowish papules caused by deposits of triglycerides in skin due to very high blood fat levels
symptoms: appear on buttocks elbows and knees

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: fat deposits erupting in skin caused by severe Kapha and Medha Dhatu imbalance
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Kapha causing excessive Medha accumulation in blood leading to skin deposits, with Pitta causing inflammation around the deposits

prevention: follow low-fat diet especially low triglyceride diet
manage thyroid and other underlying conditions

dosha_advice.vata: stable nourishing but low-fat diet, avoid erratic eating habits
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling low-fat diet, avoid spicy and fried foods, bitter vegetables beneficial
dosha_advice.kapha: strict low-fat low-sugar diet is essential, regular exercise, avoid all heavy oily and sweet foods

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Eruptive xanthoma indicates dangerously high triglycerides which can cause pancreatitis. This is a medical emergency requiring urgent specialist care in pregnancy.

child.special_advice: Eruptive xanthoma in children indicates a serious familial lipid disorder. Urgent specialist paediatric metabolic evaluation is essential.
child.ayurvedic_note: Strict Kapha-reducing diet from childhood with medical guidance is essential for managing familial lipid disorders.

teenager.special_advice: Investigate urgently for familial hypertriglyceridaemia or uncontrolled diabetes in teenagers with eruptive xanthoma.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Strict Kapha-reducing diet avoiding all heavy oily sweet and fried foods is the most important Ayurvedic measure.

elderly.special_advice: Review all medications for lipid-raising side effects. Control diabetes and thyroid disease as priority.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Kapha accumulates with age especially with reduced activity. Strict low-fat diet and regular gentle exercise are essential.

diseases.name: Lichen Simplex Chronicus

western.description: chronic skin condition caused by repeated scratching and rubbing leading to thickened leathery skin
symptoms: located on neck ankles wrists and genitals

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: thickened itching skin caused by chronic Vata-Kapha accumulation from repeated scratching
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing intense itching initiating the scratch cycle with Kapha causing progressive skin thickening and leathery change from repeated trauma

seek psychological support for chronic itch-scratch habit

unsafe_treatments: salicylic acid shampoo in large quantities
ayurvedic_safe: warm coconut or neem oil scalp massage
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Pityriasis amiantacea can be managed safely with gentle scalp care during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before using medicated shampoos.

child.special_advice: Common in children often associated with scalp eczema or ringworm. Treat underlying cause and gently remove scales.
child.ayurvedic_note: Warm coconut oil scalp massage and neem rinse are safe and effective for children.

teenager.special_advice: Often associated with scalp psoriasis or seborrheic dermatitis in teenagers. Regular medicated shampoo and scale management help.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Kapha-Vata scalp imbalance responds well to neem oil massage and light diet in teenagers.

elderly.special_advice: Investigate for underlying scalp psoriasis or seborrheic dermatitis. Gentle scalp care and regular dermatology review are essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata increases in elderly causing scalp dryness. Warm oil massage combined with light Kapha management is important.

diseases.name: Cutaneous Amyloidosis

western.description: skin condition caused by abnormal protein deposits called amyloid in the skin causing itchy pigmented patches or papules
symptoms: itchy hyperpigmented patches on upper back and shins
small firm papules in macular type
mainly affects Asian and Middle Eastern populations
causes: abnormal amyloid protein deposition in skin

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: abnormal protein deposition in skin caused by Vata-Kapha imbalance in deeper skin tissue
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing abnormal tissue transformation in skin with Kapha causing accumulation and deposition of altered protein in skin tissue

prevention: keep nails short to reduce scratch damage

dosha_advice.vata: daily warm sesame oil massage to reduce scratching urge, calming Vata routine, nourishing diet
dosha_advice.pitta: sun protection, cooling diet, avoid irritating products on affected areas
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce protein accumulation tendency, gentle exercise, regular skin care

metadata.western_source: DermNet NZ, British Association of Dermatologists

ayurvedic_safe: warm sesame oil massage on affected areas
pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Cutaneous amyloidosis is chronic and requires ongoing management. Emollients and itch control are the safe approaches in pregnancy. Consult your doctor.

child.special_advice: Rare in children. Any persistent itchy hyperpigmented patches require specialist evaluation.
child.ayurvedic_note: Medical evaluation is the priority in children before any supportive treatment.

teenager.special_advice: Can present in teenagers especially of Asian descent. Sun protection and itch management are the main interventions.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Kapha calming through warm oil massage and nourishing diet helps reduce the itch-scratch cycle.

elderly.special_advice: Investigate for systemic amyloidosis in elderly with new cutaneous amyloid deposits. Regular dermatology and internal medicine review are both important.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata dominance in elderly worsens skin deposits. Daily warm oil massage and nourishing diet are important supportive measures.

diseases.name: Porokeratosis

western.description: group of skin disorders characterized by abnormal keratinization with a distinctive raised cornoid lamella border around atrophic skin patches
symptoms: raised ridged border around skin patch
increased skin cancer risk in long-standing lesions
complications: squamous cell carcinoma risk in long-standing lesions

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: circular keratinization disorder caused by Vata-Pitta imbalance in skin cell renewal
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Vata causing abnormal skin cell renewal cycle with Pitta driving the abnormal keratinocyte proliferation forming the characteristic border

prevention: annual skin checks for any changes
report any change in lesion to doctor

dosha_advice.vata: warm sesame oil on surrounding skin, nourishing diet, sun protection
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet, strict sun avoidance, cooling aloe vera on surrounding skin
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet, regular exercise, sun protection

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Porokeratosis is managed with monitoring and sun protection during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before any treatment.

child.special_advice: Some forms present in childhood. Strict sun protection from an early age is essential to reduce progression.
child.ayurvedic_note: Sun protection and nourishing diet are the main supportive measures for children.

teenager.special_advice: Strict sun protection and annual dermatology review are the main interventions for teenagers.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta is elevated in teenagers increasing sun sensitivity. Strict sun avoidance and cooling diet are important.

elderly.special_advice: Long-standing lesions in elderly carry malignant transformation risk. Six-monthly dermatology checks are essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Vata-Pitta imbalance with cumulative sun damage in elderly needs cooling diet and strict sun protection alongside regular screening.

diseases.name: Hailey-Hailey Disease

western.description: rare inherited blistering disorder affecting skin folds causing recurrent painful erosions and crusting
symptoms: painful blisters and erosions in skin folds
worsens with heat sweat and friction
causes: mutation in ATP2C1 gene affecting calcium transport
breakdown of cell adhesion in epidermis

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: hereditary erosive skin condition in body folds caused by Pitta-Kapha imbalance from birth
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Inherited Pitta-Kapha imbalance causing skin cell adhesion failure in fold areas, with Pitta causing erosions and Kapha causing moist crusting

prevention: keep skin folds clean and dry

dosha_advice.vata: gentle skin care, avoid stress and erratic routine
dosha_advice.pitta: cooling diet, strictly keep folds clean and cool, avoid spicy foods and heat
dosha_advice.kapha: strict dryness in folds, light diet, avoid heavy oily foods and tight clothing

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Hailey-Hailey disease may worsen during pregnancy due to increased sweating and hormonal changes. Specialist care is essential throughout pregnancy.

child.special_advice: Rare before puberty. Genetic counselling for affected families is important. Skin fold hygiene education is essential.
child.ayurvedic_note: Skin fold hygiene and cooling diet are supportive measures for children alongside medical management.

teenager.special_advice: Often first presents at puberty due to increased sweating. Keeping cool and strict skin fold hygiene are the main management priorities.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Kapha imbalance worsens at puberty. Cooling diet and strict fold hygiene are critically important.

elderly.special_advice: Often improves with age as sweating reduces. Continue specialist monitoring and prompt treatment of infections.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Reduced sweating in elderly lessens triggers. Continued gentle skin care and infection management are still important.

diseases.name: Subcorneal Pustular Dermatosis

western.description: rare chronic skin condition causing superficial sterile pustules arranged in annular or serpiginous patterns mainly on trunk and limb flexures
symptoms: superficial pustules in ring or snake-like patterns
pustules filled with clear fluid turning yellow
pustules that rupture leaving crusted erosions
causes: possible association with IgA monoclonal gammopathy
complications: association with multiple myeloma in some cases

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: superficial sterile pustular skin condition caused by Pitta-Kapha imbalance with immune involvement
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta aggravation causing sterile inflammation just under skin surface with Kapha creating pus accumulation in superficial blisters

prevention: annual blood tests including protein electrophoresis

dosha_advice.vata: nourishing calm diet and routine, avoid stress
dosha_advice.pitta: strictly cooling diet, avoid spicy and fermented foods, blood-purifying bitter vegetables
dosha_advice.kapha: light diet to reduce pus formation tendency, gentle exercise

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis requires specialist monitoring in pregnancy. Most treatments carry risks. Consult your specialist immediately.

child.special_advice: Very rare in children. Any sterile pustular eruption requires urgent specialist evaluation.
child.ayurvedic_note: Medical evaluation takes absolute priority before any supportive treatment in children.

teenager.special_advice: Rare in teenagers. Investigate for associated immune conditions. Specialist dermatology care is essential.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet and stress management are supportive measures alongside specialist medical care.

elderly.special_advice: Investigate for IgA monoclonal gammopathy and multiple myeloma in elderly with new onset. Regular blood tests are essential.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Pitta-Kapha imbalance in elderly needs cooling diet alongside thorough blood disorder investigation.

western.description: highly contagious viral infection causing itchy blister-like rash

ayurvedic.ayurveda_meaning: small pox-like skin eruptions
ayurvedic.dosha_cause: Pitta and Kapha imbalance causing fever, eruptions and fluid-filled blisters on skin surface

dosha_advice.vata: focus on warm nourishing foods and adequate rest
dosha_advice.pitta: focus on cooling foods, neem bath and avoiding scratching
dosha_advice.kapha: focus on light diet, rest and keeping blisters clean and dry

pregnancy_considerations.pregnancy_warning: Chickenpox during pregnancy is serious and can harm the baby. Seek immediate medical attention. Varicella immunoglobulin may be needed if exposed.

child.special_advice: Keep child comfortable and prevent scratching with mittens or short nails. Keep away from school until all blisters have crusted over.
child.ayurvedic_note: Neem bath cooling diet and rest are very beneficial for children with chickenpox.

teenager.special_advice: Chickenpox is more severe in teenagers than young children. Rest and hydration are essential. Avoid contact with others until all lesions crust over.
teenager.ayurvedic_note: Cooling diet rest and neem bath help manage Pitta elevation during chickenpox in teenagers.

elderly.special_advice: Chickenpox in elderly patients is rare but serious. Antiviral treatment is usually recommended. Seek immediate medical attention.
elderly.ayurvedic_note: Immune-boosting cooling diet rest and medical treatment are the priority for elderly patients.
